questions.stem_text: Verbal stimuli may be an acquired source of drive. Discuss.

options.A: Verbal cues are effective as motivational sources only in specific cultural contexts.
options.B: Only non-verbal stimuli can serve as sources of drive.
options.C: Verbal stimuli serve as a source of drive exclusively in early childhood development.
options.D: Verbal stimuli are an innate source of drive, not acquired.
options.E: Verbal stimuli are not an acquired source of drive.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Verbal cues are effective as motivational sources only in specific cultural contexts.
